whys.because: openBasket and basketAge take a Clock argument instead of reading the time themselves.

whys.why: Why do openBasket and basketAge take a Clock argument instead of reading the time?
whys.because: Their test pins the clock at 1000 and 1500 to assert an age of exactly 500.

whys.why: Why must the test pin the clock to assert an exact age?
whys.because: Date.now() advances between calls, so an age read from the platform clock is never the same twice.

whys.why: Why does an age read from the platform clock never come out the same twice?
whys.because: Age is defined as elapsed milliseconds of real time, and the platform clock is the only source of real milliseconds.

whyChain.rootCause: Basket age is defined in elapsed real milliseconds, which only the platform clock supplies, so one adapter has to read it.
